caption: The drawing depicts the upper body of a person with medium skin tone and exaggerated facial features, such as pronounced cheekbones and a wide open mouth showing teeth, looking to the left of the image. The person is wearing a loose green garment with visible folds and a red cap that covers the top of their head and ears, allowing long brown hair to flow out from underneath. The figure's left arm is bent, crossing their body, with the hand resting on the right shoulder, while the right arm is bent upwards, holding a large, tan-colored drinking vessel. The background is a plain, light beige and there are no other objects present in the image. The shading on the clothing and skin gives the drawing a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Tavern Figure
